## Parent

Part of [验证 Binance Spot Live 可信执行](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/issues/121); this slice's specification gate is [#130](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/issues/130). Starting implementation/review baseline `dev@1f8e231`; retain the standing single-ticket/public external seam and serial workflow.

## What to build

Deliver the owning fee and genuinely-required execution-FX statement end to end: the approval-bound contract, the derivation that consumes only the already-read declared commission rates and the proposal-scoped FX requirements, the single typed blocker contributed inside the approval review, the React current/captured/pre-arm display, and the paired RED/GREEN evidence. The delivered bounded FX producer supports only `EURUSD`/`USDEUR`, the workspace base currency can never be `USDT` (it must be exactly three letters) and the only permitted Spot instruments quote in `USDT`; the already-read account response does not establish the complete symbol/side commission or charging asset. The slice therefore states its reachability honestly instead of manufacturing a positive.

## Delivery log

- `57c4290` T01 contract layer: `RiskDecisionInputKind::SpotFeeFx`, `RiskDecision.spot_fee_fx`, `ApprovalReview.spot_fee_fx`, the `normalize_input_material` no-op arm, the `spot_fee_fx::derive` skeleton returning `Ok(None)`, and the review gate appended after the delivered owning gate under the same single activation predicate. Regenerated IPC schema; provably zero behaviour change (492 Rust / 0 failed / 39 pre-existing ignored).
- `4bd6f2f` T02 statement derivation: full `derive`, the `SpotDeclaredCommission` projection of the already-validated `commissionRates`, the read-only proposal-scoped FX evidence accessor, exact-decimal comparison basis (not an all-in fee estimate), required-route narrowing and qualification, the single binding blocker with route precedence, and the `None` fail-closed branch. Three public `owning_fee_fx_*` cases RED then GREEN (495 Rust / 0 failed / 39 pre-existing ignored).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1. The contract and derivation layers are delivered and bound: `RiskDecisionInputKind::SPOT_FEE_FX`, `RiskDecision.spot_fee_fx`, `ApprovalReview.spot_fee_fx` and the regenerated schema agree across Rust, JSON Schema and TypeScript.
- [ ] AC2. `derive` consumes only the bound capacity observation's declared commission rates, the proposal-scoped FX requirements and the current FX observation. `spot_capacity`'s existing unknown-key account-extension obligation is preserved verbatim alongside the new projection.
- [ ] AC3. The required-route set is narrowed to the intent-policy route plus the intent-funding route for a BUY only; the portfolio-scoped rows are excluded.
- [ ] AC4. The declared maker/taker comparison basis (not an all-in fee estimate) is selected by exact decimal comparison, proven by a case whose maker and taker rates are numerically equal but lexically different, with no `f64` and no rounding.
- [ ] AC5. Exactly one typed binding blocker is reported with route precedence over the fee-class facts, and the non-binding fact stays reported.
- [ ] AC6. The review gate reuses the delivered owning activation predicate and appends a single-line blocker after the delivered owning blocker, leaving the delivered `SPOT_OWNING_QUALIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE` branch and every existing assertion untouched.
- [ ] AC7. Prepare refuses with `RISK_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE` with no reservation and no partial state, and a change to the fee or route evidence changes `approval_review_digest`.
- [ ] AC8. The four fee-class reason codes and the identity-mismatch `Ok(None)` case are covered by derivation-contract unit tests inside the module and documented as not reachable through the public seam.
- [ ] AC9. The `extension_keys` bound is documented as bounded disclosure and proven to leave the unknown-key obligation intact.
- [ ] AC10. Actual React current/captured/pre-arm states both independent reasons, names each number's declared origin, keeps `USDT != USD` literal, offers no refresh control, and is not renewed by a later read. Keyboard 1280/768/390 without overflow and no console errors.
- [ ] AC11. Paired bilingual evidence, the paired specification and design, the S29 plan and the map reflect the honest end state: this slice is not a positive path and the parent stays OPEN. Independent serial Standards then Spec review and exact source/evidence/remote/tracker handoff close the slice.

## Blocked by

No open blocker. The delivered owning admission statement and the delivered exact-account capacity/interval reads are the actual native dependencies this slice consumes.

## Standing boundaries

No new read, host, route, credential or saved source. No relaxation of the bounded FX producer's supported pairs, no currency parity, and no widening of the base-currency validator. The delivered `CURRENCY_CONVERSION` semantics are unchanged. Full-goal scope remains; real transactions need concrete separate approval and human action, and `main` is human-reviewed PR only after full-map verification.

## Current full-goal boundary (2026-10-10)

This zero-new-read statement/refusal slice does not waive the original positive fee/FX capability. BOTH complete symbol/side commission and charging-currency evidence AND genuinely required USDT execution FX remain mandatory owning work. The ordinary host already has an official symbol commission API; no claim of provider capability absence is made. Source statement acceptance is separate from full financial qualification.

130.body:
## Parent

Part of [验证 Binance Spot Live 可信执行](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/issues/121). Starting implementation/review baseline `dev@1f8e231`; retain the standing single-ticket/public external seam and serial workflow. Actual completed dependencies are the owning Spot admission statement (S29.8) and the exact-account capacity/interval reads (S29.5/S29.6) it consumes.

## What to build

Give the owning Binance Spot Live PLACE path one more precise, current statement: the fee this intent would incur and the execution conversions this intent genuinely requires. The statement consumes only what has already been read - the declared `commissionRates` inside the bound capacity observation, the proposal-scoped FX requirements and the current FX observation - and never adds a read, host, route, credential or saved source. The fee basis is the conservative declared basis selected by exact decimal comparison; no fee amount is ever fabricated, because the venue declares commission *rates* and not the fee-charging *asset*. The required routes are narrowed to the intent path and, for a BUY only, the funding path. Both the fee evidence and the required routes are approval-bound, so a genuine change changes the approval review digest and re-admission needs a new review. When either fact cannot be established the statement fails closed with its single typed blocker and Prepare refuses with `RISK_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE`. No new authority: no Arm, consent, dispatch, probe order or source mutation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1. The fee statement and the genuinely-required execution-FX statement are derived only from already-bound seams: the declared `commissionRates` inside the bound capacity observation, the proposal-scoped FX requirements and the current FX observation. No new read, host, route, credential or saved source is added, and no renderer-supplied rate, fee, asset, route or qualification is accepted.
- [ ] AC2. Identity binding mirrors the owning statement: workspace / Proposal / proposal hash / account / instrument / BASE / QUOTE / rule-material / source-generation are compared against each other, while each observation version is validated against its own cursor and folded into the two statement version digests. Any mismatch retires the evidence instead of being reconciled by assumption.
- [ ] AC3. The required-route set is narrowed to the genuinely-required routes only: the intent-policy route always, and the intent-funding route only for a BUY. The portfolio-scoped account/balance/position/open-order rows stay the read-only review context's domain and are not silently folded into this statement.
- [ ] AC4. The declared fee basis is the conservative one, selected by exact decimal comparison and never by string comparison, with no `f64` and no rounding that could make a fee smaller than the venue's own figure. When the venue does not declare the fee-charging asset the currency is reported as UNKNOWN with its origin, and no fee amount is fabricated.
- [ ] AC5. Exactly one typed binding blocker is reported. When a structurally-unsupported required route and an undeclared fee currency co-occur, the route binds first, and the fee-currency fact remains a reported fact that is never silently dropped.
- [ ] AC6. Missing, unsupported, mismatched, stale or version-changed evidence fails closed with `RISK_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE` semantics at approval review and at Prepare; the statement never degrades into a smaller or more forgiving number, and the delivered `CURRENCY_CONVERSION` semantics are left unchanged.
- [ ] AC7. The statement is approval-bound: a genuine change to the fee evidence or to a required route changes `approval_review_digest` and leaves the review ineligible, so re-admission requires a newly reviewed approval. A refusal leaves the Proposal and approval untouched, with no reservation and no partial state.
- [ ] AC8. Actual React current/captured/pre-arm states both independent reasons in plain language, names the declared origin of every reported number, keeps `USDT != USD` literally true, exposes no refresh control, and is neither renewed nor repaired by a later get, refresh or reopen. Keyboard layout is correct at 1280/768/390 without overflow.
- [ ] AC9. Reachability is stated rather than assumed. `RiskCheckOutcome::Pass` and `SPOT_FEE_FX_QUALIFIED` are retained in the contract but are unreachable at the public seam with the delivered bounded FX producer (only `EURUSD`/`USDEUR`) and the delivered fixed ordinary hosts (the already-read account response does not establish a charging asset); the fee-class reason codes and the identity-mismatch case are therefore covered by derivation-contract unit tests and not by public product tests. No producer, supported pair, currency parity or base-currency validator is relaxed to manufacture a positive.
- [ ] AC10. Genuine public RED/GREEN, external normal/incomplete/contradictory/lifecycle tests, current full and affected suites, generated schema and paired bilingual traceability, ordinary build/pin, actual frozen UI, independent serial Standards then Spec review, and exact source/evidence/remote/tracker handoff establish this slice. The parent, S28, S17, physical S27, S33 and the `dev` to `main` merge stay OPEN.

## Blocked by

No open blocker. The completed owning admission statement and the completed exact-account capacity/interval reads are the actual native dependencies this statement consumes. No invented S28 or physical gate edge.

## Standing boundaries

Use the paired S29.9 specification and design published on the parent. The confirmed single-ticket granularity and the highest public React/Rust/disposable-storage/external-provider seam apply unchanged. This slice does not constitute a positive path: the Binance Spot Live authorization path remains unavailable at the approval review gate with the currently delivered inputs, which is correct fail-closed behaviour and not a PASS. Full-goal scope remains; real transactions need concrete separate approval and human action, and `main` is human-reviewed PR only after full-map verification.

## Current full-goal boundary (2026-10-10)

This zero-new-read statement/refusal slice does not waive the original positive fee/FX capability. BOTH complete symbol/side commission and charging-currency evidence AND genuinely required USDT execution FX remain mandatory owning work. The ordinary host already has an official symbol commission API; no claim of provider capability absence is made. Source statement acceptance is separate from full financial qualification.

fullFinancialAcceptance: NOT PASS; both fee/charging currency and required USDT execution FX outstanding
